subject: Guest Wi-Fi network unavailable at Nehru Place store
description: Guest Wi-Fi network has been down since approximately 6:30 PM today. Customers are unable to connect to the guest network, though staff Wi-Fi appears to be functioning normally. The router (RTR-0038-01) is powered on and showing normal LED indicators. This is impacting customer experience during peak evening hours.

ticket_history.note: Ticket acknowledged. Initial troubleshooting indicates guest Wi-Fi SSID is not broadcasting. Recommended power cycle of router; escalating to L2 for further diagnosis.
